proof_availability.classification_scope: For qualified full-joint local CPTP slots, b_a=(||N-aT||diamond+1-a)/2 is the least CP upper-majorant cost. Optimizing af+b_a for a coherent residual of channel angle theta gives H_theta(f)=sin^2(min(pi/2,asin sqrt(f)+theta)). Primitive local spectral-radius charges compose inside each factor of the existing causal subset product. Uniform seed-controlled angles/full reservation locality and exact reference tester contracts are indispensable. This uses established angle/SDP machinery; it supplies no actual fault flag, correctable support, physical calibration or original-generator robustness.
